title: As expected
text:
As expected. For the price, I did NOT expect a superior quality item. I read other reviews ... one mentioned it took him a couple of hours to assemble. It took me ( a girl with girl tools) about 4 hours and it was a real struggle. You really need a second person to hold pieces together as you attach. After putting it together, it will work for the closet organizer that I planned to use it for.... but it will not last for long. The particle board construction is not meant to last for long with regular use. I just wanted something "temporary" while I search for the quality piece of furniture that will last.
I will say that the shipping was well protected and while I usually get one or two pieces that are broken when ordering from Amazon, this arrived all unbroken. A nice surprise. It was well packed with copious amounts of styrofoam (I hate styrofoam - but it does the job - just have to find some way to re purpose the squares) and corners were reinforced with thick cardboard edges. A+ for packing. C- for particle board construction and assembly.
